title: Fill the import address table
description:
The loader writes the real address of each imported function into the import address table. Write

```cpp
std::vector<unsigned long long> fillIat(const std::vector<std::string>& imports,
                                        const std::map<std::string, unsigned long long>& exportRvas,
                                        unsigned long long dllBase);
```

For each imported name, in order, the slot holds `dllBase + rva` of that export, or `0` if the DLL does not export it.

```
fillIat({ "stackHeight", "stackWeight" }, { {"stackHeight", 0x1023}, {"stackWeight", 0x10A5} }, 0x7FFA10000000)
    == { 0x7FFA10001023, 0x7FFA100010A5 }
```
hints: For each imported name, in order, look it up with `exportRvas.find(name)`: found gives `dllBase + it->second`, missing gives `0`.
